evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml runs on pull_request (and push to main) with `npm ci`, `npm test`, `npm run build` in site/ (step1.patch 72-76). All of these scripts exist in site/package.json:13-16. Workflow-level `permissions: contents: read`. The PR title is passed through `env: TITLE` rather than interpolated into the script (83-85). There is no pull_request_target and no secret other than github.token. However, no action is pinned to a commit SHA: actions/checkout@v7, setup-node@v7, configure-pages@v6, upload-pages-artifact@v5 and deploy-pages@v5 are all tag-pinned (66-67, 120-126, 133, 145, 166-167). pages.yml grants `pages: write` and `id-token: write` to the whole workflow, so the build job (which runs npm ci/test/build) gets them too, when only the deploy job needs them (104-107). It also has `workflow_dispatch` with no branch guard (102), so only the github-pages environment's branch policy keeps the deploy limited to main. The release workflow is tag-only with `contents: write`, which is acceptable.
evidence.s1_readme: README (step1.patch 301-380) covers requirements, install (`cd site && npm ci`), develop (`npm run dev`), a command table, test, build/deploy with PAGES_BASE (which site/vite.config.ts:11 actually reads), contributing data (paths, issue forms that exist in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE, naming sources) and license (LICENSE and THIRD-PARTY.md exist). Every command shown (dev, test, build, preview, prepare-data, sample-bullets, npm ci) exists in site/package.json. The only claim I could not confirm is the `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` mention: that file is not in app/, but it may have been excluded as an environment file.
evidence.s1_release: There is one strategy, stated in CONTRIBUTING.md and README: SemVer, version only in site/package.json (0.1.0), `vX.Y.Z` tags, a release PR that runs `npm version --no-git-tag-version` and dates the Unreleased section, then a tag push. release.yml checks that the tag matches package.json and that CHANGELOG.md has a matching section, runs test and build, and creates the release with that section as its notes (step1.patch 172-190). CHANGELOG.md states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0. Dependabot covers npm in /site and github-actions, with `build`/`ci` prefixes that pass the PR-title regex. Conventional Commits is stated with a type table, and all 10 commits in commits.txt follow it.
evidence.s2_requirements: The route `#/compare/<a>/<b>` is parsed with decodeURIComponent and has an href builder (step2.patch 343-359), and App.svelte loads Compare.svelte lazily. The SVG has role=img and aria-label from 'Profiles of {a} and {b}' with record names (Compare.svelte:44-55), and each outline is one `<path>` from fullSectionPath. Rows come from the cartridge part only, numbers only, with Tol fields and FIELD_UNITS entries excluded (compare.ts dimensions()). The caption is 'Dimensions (mm|in)'. Headers are Symbol / name A / name B / Difference, the symbol comes from FIELD_LABELS, and Difference is B−A. Metric values use formatValue, imperial uses displayNumber(...,'in'), and the unit system comes from unitSystem(). The detail page has `<label for=compare-with>Compare with` on a NativeSelect, whose id reaches the `<select>` via restProps, listing the other non-shot cartridges by name, plus a Compare button that sets href.compare(key, compareKey). German strings are provided. Tests, a changelog entry and conventional commits are present. I found no unmet requirement.
evidence.s2_correctness: Both profiles go through one viewportFor(profiles, {scale: 8, frame: 'upright'}), so they share one scale and one axis at r=0. caseOuterProfile starts at z=0 (rimProfile, case.ts:405-420), so both head faces land at the same y. Values for 308 Win./300 Win. Mag. come straight from the record. The metric difference is trimmed with toPrecision(12) to remove float noise (16.160000000000004 → 16.16), matching what displayNumber does for inches. Unknown keys, shot cartridges and cases that cannot be drawn (MissingDimensionError) each get a status message. A minor point: within a group, rows follow JSON key order rather than the detail page's FIELD_ORDER, even though the comment says 'in the order the detail page lists them' (compare.ts dimensions()).
evidence.s2_fit: The feature reuses lib/core (FIELD_LABELS, FIELD_UNITS, GROUP_ORDER, formatValue), lib/geom (viewportFor, fullSectionPath), lib/shapes2d (adaptMetallic, caseOuterProfile), site units.displayNumber, NativeSelect, ShadcnButton and PageLoadError. It follows the framework-free site/src/lib pattern with a Svelte route, `@layer legacy` scoped styles and the data-ui wrapper. Weaknesses: dimensions() reimplements the Tol filtering and field ordering instead of using `orderedFields` from lib/core/fields.ts, which also leaves the order inconsistent. The new i18n keys sit under the '// The bullet catalogue.' comment in both en and de (step2.patch 245-246, 265-266). There is a stray trailing space in the Cartridge.svelte button markup.
evidence.s2_tests: compare.test.ts follows the repository's Vitest style, reading real records through lib/testing/fixtures. It covers: symbols written as the detail page does, exclusion of non-mm/Tol/angle fields, chamber exclusion, metric formatting and B−A, float noise, imperial conversion, both outlines as single closed paths with head faces level and the same axis, the one scale (height ratio equals mouth z ratio, scale 8), and every metallic record either drawing or failing with MissingDimensionError. router.test.ts covers parse/href round trips and malformed hashes. Not covered: the SVG accessible name, the caption and headers, and the Compare-with control. The repository has no component-test setup, so this is understandable. The metric test computes its expected difference with the same toPrecision formula, which makes it partly tautological.
evidence.s3_fixes: Point 1: dimensionRows now takes the union of both field sets, and formatRow returns '' for a missing value and its difference (step3.patch 77-112). New tests assert that 'delta L' (308 only) and 'R3' (300 WM only) are listed with empty b/a and difference cells, in both metric and imperial. The lede and 'none' strings and the changelog line were updated to match. Point 2: the step-2 CSS already set `th, td {text-align: right}` with only the first column left (step2.patch 538-539), so the alignment was already right. Step 3 only added `class="num"` to the three headers (step3.patch 173-175), which applies the monospace figure font as GroupTable does. That is consistent with the detail page but is a font change, not an alignment change. Rows only one cartridge publishes are appended after A's rows, which is acceptable. I found no regressions.
evidence.cross_step: Steps 2 and 3 each update `## [Unreleased] / ### Added` in CHANGELOG.md. Step 3 corrects the unreleased Added line instead of adding a Fixed entry, which is right for an unreleased feature. The version stays at 0.1.0, which matches the stated strategy (bump only in the release PR). Commits use feat/style/fix/docs. The code type-checks by reading: optional Row fields, conditional narrowing in formatRow, and the Record<Route['view'],…> map in metadata.ts extended for 'compare'. The new tests are consistent with the data, so CI's `npm test` and `npm run build` should pass.

unmet_requirements: Step 1 / CI criterion: GitHub Actions are pinned to version tags (@v7, @v6, @v5), not full commit SHAs.

Step 1 / CI criterion: pages.yml grants pages: write and id-token: write to the whole workflow, including the build job, which is broader than least privilege; workflow_dispatch has no main-only guard.
strengths: The compare view meets every step 2 requirement and reuses lib/core, lib/geom and lib/shapes2d (viewportFor, fullSectionPath, caseOuterProfile, formatValue, FIELD_LABELS/FIELD_UNITS, displayNumber) instead of reimplementing geometry or formatting.

A coherent release strategy: SemVer in site/package.json, Keep a Changelog, and a tag-triggered release that checks the version and the changelog section. Conventional Commits is enforced on PR titles, all commits follow it, and later steps maintain the changelog.
Meaningful tests against real records: head faces level, shared axis and scale, exclusion rules, imperial conversion, every metallic record, and the step 3 regression cases (delta L, R3).
issues: Actions are not pinned to commit SHAs in any of the three workflows (checkout@v7, setup-node@v7, configure-pages@v6, upload-pages-artifact@v5, deploy-pages@v5).

pages.yml's permissions are broader than needed: pages/id-token write is granted workflow-wide, so it also reaches the build job, which runs npm ci and the tests. workflow_dispatch can be started from any branch, and only the environment's branch policy stops a deploy from it.

The step 3 style point was already satisfied by the step 2 CSS; the step 3 change only switches the header font to monospace. Separately, dimensions() duplicates part of orderedFields, so rows within a group follow JSON order rather than the detail page's order, and the compare i18n keys sit under the 'bullet catalogue' comment.
review.verdict: The compare feature and its step 3 fix are correct, well tested and built from the repository's existing modules, and the release, changelog and commit conventions are consistent and followed across all steps. Before merging, the workflows need SHA-pinned actions and job-scoped Pages permissions.
